```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'Pull Request number'
        required: true
        type: string
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
        type: string
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate inputs
        id: validate
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]; then
            echo "pr_input_missing=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post error comment if validation fails
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            Error: Missing required input 'pr'. Please provide the pull request number.
            Example usage: `/ai-docs-review pr=12345`

      - name: Checkout PR head
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing != 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head

      - name: Get changed files with pagination
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing != 'true'
        id: get_files
        run: |
          gh api --paginate -X GET "/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files" \
            --jq '.[] | .filename' > changed_files.txt
          echo "changed_files_count=$(wc -l < changed_files.txt)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Post start comment
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing != 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            Starting AI documentation review for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}...
            Files to review: ${{ steps.get_files.outputs.changed_files_count }}

      - name: Run AI docs review
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing != 'true'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          # Note: The !connectordocs-pr-review playbook does not exist yet - will be created separately

      - name: Post skip comment if no files changed
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing != 'true' && steps.get_files.outputs.changed_files_count == 0
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            Skipping AI documentation review for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}.
            No documentation files were changed.

      - name: Post completion comment
        if: steps.validate.outputs.pr_input_missing != 'true' && steps.get_files.outputs.changed_files_count > 0
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            AI documentation review completed for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}.
            Review results available in the action logs.
```
